brief.voice: Calm, credible self-agency. No promise that using the app earns money.
brief.display: Mobile quote surface; measured length and layout limits are unavailable.

records.text: I pause before buying what will not matter next month.
I spend slowly when a decision can wait.
I use my budget as a map, not a punishment.
I see wealth as room to be useful.
You deserve respect while you grow, {userName}.

import.text: I am worthy of respect as the Gg I currently am, even if I am working to become a better Gg.

curation.reason: Preserves a distinct useful reflection in direct second-person address using the canonical name token.

records.text: No one should ever tell me how I feel about myself; only I get to decide who I am and what kind of life I want.
